scope: analysis only; no Method; no plant or scene edits; no data downloads

remus.method: F polynomial in N, d in mm; solve first unique rising F crossing inside fitMaxDispl; k=dF/dd, n=d*k/F; no extrapolation

dahmani.caveat: six acquisitions at different locations, not six technical repeats; residual contains shape error and quantization, not identified sensor noise; offset cause unidentifiable

callera.limitations: summary workbook only; E_Hz is a column label, not frequency; DMA frequency/amplitude and indentation ramp/time-series absent; creep Force [N] label not independently verified; no energy denominator

corona_radiata.interpreted_columns: time s, force N, displacement mm (CSV has no header; identification from paper geometry and loading velocity)
corona_radiata.preprocessing: published moving average + RDP point reduction; small minimum dt is not usable acquisition bandwidth

visual_cortex.interpreted_columns: time s, force N, displacement mm (CSV has no header; identification from paper geometry and loading velocity)
visual_cortex.preprocessing: published moving average + RDP point reduction; small minimum dt is not usable acquisition bandwidth

rheometer.provenance: MD5 matches Zenodo 17152951, porcine spinal cord multimodal pipeline; not 14536174 indentation archive
rheometer.units: geometry in m (radius .004); displacement m and force N consistent with SI preprocessor; time is integer row index 0..n-1 after reduction, not seconds; no physical rate or Hz inferred
rheometer.limitations: hyperelastic preprocessing averages loading/unloading; individual c1/c2/c3 files also have one-way displacement branches, not closed loops; neither those nor mean_neg/pos can measure hysteresis

dynamics.convention: analytic frozen material H=1+sum(alpha*iw*tau/(1+iw*tau))+iw*lambda, F0=k=1; same measured normalized compression displacement/time protocols; equilibrium modulus set to 1, no abdominal parameter transfer; no arm/sensor/support
dynamics.caveat: HC normalized lambda uses F0/k=1 depth unit; large compression protocol is a shape diagnostic, not a fit of glued tensile brain data or finite probe contact

scanning.prompt: Acquire the left kidney long-axis view
scanning.inference: meters and radians plausible from 0.48..0.58 coordinate and UR-sized workspace, not specified in data card; Euler follows roll/pitch/yaw labels, rotvec is alternative. Global pose frame, force frame, calibration, TCP/probe axis and force sign unresolved. Nonzero wrench is not confirmed contact. Magnitude is wrench-force magnitude, not established tissue normal force. Initial exact zero block may be unavailable/uninitialized wrench or noncontact, not noise proof.
scanning.bandwidth: 30 FPS, Nyquist 15 Hz; no 20.8 Hz phase, intrinsic noise, actuator lag, indentation or body motion identification

noise.readme: sensor sigma is injected before IIR; random walk is separate

A2_last_slope_cap_hazard.interpretation: negative last map slope makes internal cover caps negative; consequence of inconsistent A2 source and unchecked extrapolation, not a measured bone property

beber.note: Vector re-extracted from local PDF; partial loop 1..14mm, not complete closed-cycle loss. No time base in force-depth figure; hysteresis must not be converted to 20.8Hz phase.
